contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= n <= 1000","description":"The number of abbreviations n must be between 1 and 1000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(1 <= len(abbreviation) <= 10 for abbreviation in abbreviations)","description":"Each abbreviation must have a length between 1 and 10 characters."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(abbreviation.startswith('IAO\'') for abbreviation in abbreviations)","description":"Each abbreviation must start with the prefix 'IAO' followed by a single quote."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"all(stdout == str(year) for abbreviation, year in zip(abbreviations, years))","description":"The output must contain the correct year for each abbreviation."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(year >= 1989 for year in years)","description":"The determined year for each abbreviation must be at least 1989."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(len(str(year)) == len(abbreviation) - 4 for abbreviation, year in zip(abbreviations, years))","description":"The length of the year must match the length of the abbreviation minus the prefix length."}],"invariants":[]}
